The model beats the nomination by **7.2%** (in terms of MAE reduction). 

Specifically, the model's MAE was 5412.9 compared to the nomination's baseline MAE of 5834.2, giving an absolute improvement of -421.3 (lower is better). This improvement is statistically significant, with a 95% confidence interval of -688.5 to -153.2.
